certificate_verification.initial_runner_failure: NSS SEC_ERROR_READ_ONLY (-8126) prevented Chromium from using the existing platform-approved trust database; the earlier browser run stopped before navigation.
certificate_verification.correction: Anonymous Chromium ran with approved filesystem access for normal NSS initialization. Existing trusted roots and normal TLS validation were preserved.

hosted_acceptance.scope: Anonymous public HTTPS, private dependency readiness through Web, synthetic demonstration, responsive rendering and rejection boundaries. No customer/provider account or model credentials were used.

real_provider_acceptance.business_history_limits: Eligible Meta Business Coexistence onboarding only; up to 180 days of supported one-to-one history, with provider eligibility and sharing timing requirements. It is not general personal/group account history access.
real_provider_acceptance.message_intelligence_scope: Explicitly authorized, retained chat messages and attributed human-owner examples; bounded retrieval/local style refresh. No account-wide history access or model fine-tuning is established.

remaining_release_gates: Configure Google Web OAuth client ID/secret, registered HTTPS callback and test users; verify the same real Google subject on web and installed iOS/Android.
Configure Meta Business assets, webhook secrets/token, verified owner binding, recipient opt-in and per-chat grants; verify signed ingress and real reply delivery before enabling production sends.
For eligible Business Coexistence, complete provider onboarding/history sharing and independently attribute human-owner examples.
Configure model credentials, model/pricing and budgets; measure actual answer quality and cost on authorized messages.
Signed installed iOS/Android builds, background/deep-link/secure-storage/permission acceptance and store review remain unrun.
General native forwarding/provider adapters remain unavailable beyond explicitly supported tested routes; synthetic dispatch acceptance does not prove real forwarding.
50,000 simultaneous users and production autoscaling are not certified; the existing deployment has one running instance per service.
Managed Postgres restore, Redis runtime persistence and direct private SQL/cache probes remain unrun. READY volumes and local recovery evidence do not prove managed recovery.

Full container reports retain unfixed HIGH/CRITICAL base-image findings, and the native dependency audit retains 29 affected nodes (21 high, 8 moderate). Zero fixable HIGH/CRITICAL gate findings is not a vulnerability-free claim.
